report_topic: Mining in Uttar Pradesh and Socio-Economic Impact of Illegal Mining
observations_summary: The audit revealed significant non-compliance and irregularities in mining operations in Uttar Pradesh, including the granting of leases near bridges, delayed deposit of security and royalty, and non-collection of financial assurance. It also found widespread illegal mining, operation of stone crushers and brick kilns in violation of norms, and deficiencies in revenue collection, internal controls, and monitoring mechanisms, leading to substantial revenue loss.
